script_text: Aquarius, June is not a soft landing; it is the month your air-sign mind gets a cosmic audit, and the results are oddly liberating. The dominant transit is Mercury retrograde in Gemini, your 5th House, trining Saturn in Aries and squaring Neptune in Aries: old creative projects, flirtations, and childlike dreams return for repair before they can be approved. Venus in Leo lights your 7th House, so romance gets theatrical, loyal, and honest; a partner or serious date asks for clarity before the June 29 Venus retrograde. Saturn in Aries supports your 3rd House of contracts, while Jupiter in Cancer in your 6th House expands paid routines, health systems, and client work. Mars in Taurus in your 4th House gives steady vitality but warns against stubborn tension in the body. Watch June 18, June 21, and June 29. Avoid rushing emotional promises. Comment your sign.
